'''Wavelength Gale''' was a [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]] group active around the time of the [[First Jedi Purge]]. They had a [[Wavelength Gale's hidden cove|base]] located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Volik]], in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]], and it was rumoured that the smugglers had acquired [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Nihilus]]'s [[Mask of Darth Nihilus|mask]].<ref name=":Mask of Darth Nihilus" />
